# Definitive

## Docs

- [MCP Guide](https://ddp.definitive.fi/mcp-guide): Definitive has an MCP server (`@definitive-fi/mcp`) that lets AI assistants — Claude, Cursor, and others — interact with your portfolio. Check positions, review transfers, look up orders, trade, bridge assets cross-chain, and more through natural language.
- [Building With Definitive](https://ddp.definitive.fi/overview): This guide walks you through building an application that serves many users using Definitive's Organization API. Whether you're creating an app, Telegram bot, trading terminal or something else, this guide provides the step-by-step process for integrating Definitive's execution infrastructure.
- [Request Authorization](https://ddp.definitive.fi/request-authorization): The next section covers manual signing and sending of requests, however we have also authored this AuthHelpers class with signAndSend to simplify the process.
- [Supported Networks](https://ddp.definitive.fi/supported-networks): Definitive's API supports trading and position management across multiple blockchain networks. You can use the same API interface to interact with any of our supported networks.
- [Advanced Trading with Definitive](https://ddp.definitive.fi/why-definitive): Definitive launches institutional-grade trade execution for on-chain markets, now accessible to all DeFi traders.
- [Making Your First Request](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/getting-started): This guide walks through making your first authenticated request to the Definitive API. The same authentication mechanism applies to both the **Portfolio API** and the **Organization API** — the only difference is the URL paths.
- [Portfolio vs. Organization API](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/portfolio-vs-organization): Definitive offers two API modes that share the same trading, portfolio, and bridge endpoints. The difference is **scope and authentication**.
- [Get Bridge Quote](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/bridge/quote): Get a quote for bridging assets across chains. Returns available routes sorted by output amount (highest first), not sorted by timing or speed.
- [Submit Bridge](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/bridge/submit): Submit a bridge transaction using a route from a bridge quote.
- [Get Order Details](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/orders/details): Retrieves detailed information about a specific order, including execution details, fill events, and current status.
- [List Orders](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/orders/list): Retrieves the order history for a portfolio, including all order types and their current status.
- [List Portfolios](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/organization/portfolios): Retrieves all portfolios managed by the organization. This endpoint supports cursor-based pagination for efficient handling of large portfolio datasets.
- [Get Portfolio Details](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/portfolio-info/details): Retrieves detailed metadata about a specific portfolio, including the vaults it controls.
- [Get Deposit Address](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/portfolio-info/get-deposit-address): Retrieves the deposit address for a portfolio's vault on a specific blockchain. This endpoint is useful for getting the vault address where users should send their deposits.
- [List Positions](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/portfolio-info/positions): Retrieves all current positions held in a portfolio, including token balances and their USD values. Supports cursor-based pagination for efficient handling of large position datasets.
- [List Transfers](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/portfolio-info/transfers): Retrieves the transfer history for a portfolio, including deposits, withdrawals, swaps, and cross-chain bridge transfers across all vaults.
- [Cancel QuickTrade Order](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/quicktrade/cancel): Cancel an active QuickTrade order that has not yet been fully executed. Only orders with status `ORDER_STATUS_PENDING`, `ORDER_STATUS_ACCEPTED`, or `ORDER_STATUS_PARTIALLY_FILLED` can be cancelled. See [Order Statuses](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/reference/order-statuses) for a complete reference of all available statuses.
- [Get QuickTrade Quote](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/quicktrade/quote): Get a quote for a QuickTrade order without executing it. This is useful when you want to preview pricing before using the QuickTrade submit endpoint.
- [QuickTrade](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/quicktrade/submit): Execute trades instantly with just one API call. QuickTrade automatically generates a quote and executes your order immediately, eliminating the need for separate quote and submit steps.
- [Action Types](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/reference/action-types): This page documents all possible action types used throughout the Definitive API. These action types are used in transfer history, vault operations, and portfolio management endpoints.
- [Order Statuses](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/reference/order-statuses): This page documents all possible order statuses used throughout the Definitive API. These statuses are used in order management, cancellation, and status checking endpoints.
- [Cancel Order](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/trade/cancel): Cancels an active order that has not yet been fully executed. Only orders with status `ORDER_STATUS_PENDING`, `ORDER_STATUS_ACCEPTED`, or `ORDER_STATUS_PARTIALLY_FILLED` can be cancelled. See [Order Statuses](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/reference/order-statuses) for a complete reference of all available statuses.
- [Get Quote](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/trade/quote): Retrieves a quote for trading between two assets. The request body varies based on the order type.
- [Submit Order](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/trade/submit): Submits a trade order using a previously obtained quote. The order will be executed according to the quote parameters and current market conditions.
- [Create Portfolio](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/organization/portfolio/create): Creates a new portfolio within the organization. This endpoint allows organizations to programmatically create portfolios for their trading activities.
- [Get Portfolio Fees](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/organization/portfolio/fees): Retrieve fee data for a specific portfolio within a given time range.
- [Refresh Balance](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/organization/portfolio/refresh-balance): Forces a refresh of a portfolio's vault balance data from the blockchain. You must specify either a vault ID or a chain to refresh.
- [Withdraw](https://ddp.definitive.fi/api/organization/portfolio/withdraw): Initiates a withdrawal of assets from a portfolio's vault to an external wallet.
